## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The alert body for a session_expired failure contains the refresh command...

The system SHALL ensure that the alert body for a session_expired failure contains the refresh command and no cookie value, proven with the real emitter rather than a stubbed telemetry_emitter.

#### Scenario: The alert body for a session_expired failure contains the refresh command...

WHEN `classify-session-expired-in-the-terminal-event-outbox` is implemented
THEN The alert body for a session_expired failure contains the refresh command and no cookie value, proven with the real emitter rather than a stubbed telemetry_emitter.

### Requirement: Before the outbox lands, the scheduled real-ingestion evidence artifact...

The system SHALL ensure that before the outbox lands, the scheduled real-ingestion evidence artifact records the session_expired code for the affected source.

#### Scenario: Before the outbox lands, the scheduled real-ingestion evidence artifact...

WHEN `classify-session-expired-in-the-terminal-event-outbox` is implemented
THEN Before the outbox lands, the scheduled real-ingestion evidence artifact records the session_expired code for the affected source.
